FN Squad policies

Privacy notice

How this site handles your browser preferences, external links and community reports.

On this pageWebsite visitsExternal platformsCommunity reportsRequests and complaintsRetention and securityLaws and referencesTransparencyBahasa Melayu

Website visits

FN Squad is an independent community based in Malaysia. The website itself has no registration or upload forms, analytics scripts, advertising trackers or social embeds. FreakyNews search and topic filters run in your browser.

Your browser saves your appearance choice under fn-theme. Clear the site’s browser data to remove it.

GitHub Pages hosts the public FN Squad site and records visitor IP addresses for security. See GitHub Pages data collection.

External platforms

When you open a link to a third-party service, that provider handles your visit, account activity and settings under its own policies. In a WhatsApp group, other members can see your phone number. WhatsApp Channels apply different visibility rules for followers.

WhatsApp privacy policy · Group privacy settings · Channel privacy · Discord privacy policy

Community reports

Staff may receive usernames, messages, screenshots, timestamps and relevant Minecraft server logs when investigating reports, enforcing rules or reviewing appeals. Send reports privately and limit them to relevant information. Redact unrelated personal details from screenshots.

Ask staff who can see the report and how long it may be retained before sharing sensitive evidence.

Requests and complaints

Email fnsquadofficial@gmail.com to ask about the information FN Squad holds, request a correction or deletion, or raise a concern. Include the platform and approximate date. Send provider-held data requests to that provider.

For Malaysian personal data complaints, see the Personal Data Protection Commissioner (JPDP). For communications and multimedia matters, see MCMC complaint channels.

Retention and security

FN Squad’s public materials do not specify a fixed retention schedule for reports or server logs. Ask about the retention period for your case. External providers apply their own retention practices.

Report suspected unauthorised disclosure privately using the contact options above.

Laws and references

Malaysia’s Personal Data Protection Act 2010 and its amendments address personal data processing in connection with commercial transactions. Applicable obligations depend on the activity and circumstances. The JPDP sources explain the Act and its scope.

Act 709 and amendments · JPDP guidance on scope

Transparency

The statement on GitHub records the public site’s original privacy review and the governance questions it identified, including ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27701 as planning references.

Public transparency statement on GitHub

Notis Privasi FN Squad

Lawatan laman web

Kod laman ini tidak menggunakan analitik, penjejak iklan, borang pendaftaran atau borang muat naik. Carian FreakyNews dijalankan dalam pelayar. Tetapan tema disimpan dalam storan setempat pelayar dan boleh dipadamkan melalui tetapan pelayar.

GitHub Pages mengehoskan laman awam FN Squad dan merekodkan alamat IP untuk tujuan keselamatan. Rujuk maklumat GitHub Pages.

Platform luar dan laporan

Ahli kumpulan WhatsApp boleh melihat nombor telefon anda. Saluran WhatsApp menggunakan tetapan keterlihatan yang berbeza. Hantar laporan terus kepada pentadbir atau moderator dan padamkan butiran peribadi yang tidak berkaitan. Sila tanya tempoh penyimpanan bagi laporan anda.

Pertanyaan dan aduan

E-mel fnsquadofficial@gmail.com untuk pertanyaan, pembetulan atau permohonan pemadaman. Rujuk JPDP bagi aduan berkaitan data peribadi dan saluran aduan MCMC bagi perkara komunikasi dan multimedia. Skop Akta 709 bergantung pada aktiviti dan keadaan.
